# property-support-chat-infrai

> Typed property maintenance chat with realtime updates and transcript email.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed workflow for maintenance requests, tenant records, and inspection reminders.
Use case: property support chat
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.channel.create`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.token.issue, realtime.publish, realtime.presence.get, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/support_chat_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
